I’ll check how the two `latest` forms resolve versions and add a regression test. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill for the change.
The SQL registry store returns the first per-stage latest version for `@latest`. I’ll change it to select the highest numeric version and test stage combinations, including Archived, with workspaces both enabled and disabled.
The 36 focused registry tests pass, covering all stage combinations and workspace modes. The existing prompt alias test hit an unrelated tracing configuration error during setup; I’m rerunning it with the OTLP endpoint settings cleared for that process.
Changed `@latest` resolution to select the highest numeric version across all stages, including Archived, matching `/latest`.

Added regression coverage for stage combinations and workspace modes. All 36 focused registry tests and the existing prompt alias test passed; pytest’s final reporting hit a sandbox permission error.

No dependencies installed or full test suite run.

+def test_get_model_version_by_latest_alias_across_stages(store, older_stage, latest_stage):
+    name = "LatestAliasAcrossStages"
+    store.create_registered_model(name)
+    for _ in range(10):
+        store.create_model_version(name, "source", "run_id")
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(name, "9", older_stage, archive_existing_versions=False)

+

+    assert int(version.version) == 10
+    assert version.current_stage == latest_stage

+    path_name, path_version = get_model_name_and_version(store, f"models:/{name}/latest")
+    assert alias_name == path_name == name
+    assert int(alias_version) == int(path_version) == 10
